spanish: Aparte de holocausto del mes y su minjá, y holocausto del continuo y su minjá, y sus libaciones, conforme a su juicio, a olor de reposo, ofrenda de fuego a Jehová.

findings.issue: minjá leaves the common noun H4503 untranslated as a Hebraized lemma; a common noun must be Spanish

notes: The rest of the verse matches number, suffixes, construct chains, and Jehová.
